name: AICS International Shipping
author: Chirag Dodiya

sections.description:
AICS International Shipping is designed for businesses in India looking to expand globally.
This plugin enables WooCommerce store owners to provide real-time, dynamic shipping rates for customers across multiple countries.
Key Features:
– Dynamic shipping rates from India to international destinations
– Multi-city origin support (e.g., Surat, Mumbai, Delhi, etc.)
– Simple integration with WooCommerce checkout
– Easy configuration from the WordPress admin panel
– Regularly updated shipping rates based on logistics data
With AICS Logistics’ expertise in international shipping, this plugin helps eCommerce stores save time, reduce errors, and offer transparent pricing to their customers.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin and upload it to your WordPress site via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping and configure AICS International Shipping.
  4. Enter your shipping credentials and set up your origin city.
  5. Save changes and your store will start displaying dynamic international shipping rates.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work only for India-based stores?

Yes, this plugin is designed specifically for stores shipping products from India to international destinations.

Do I need an account with AICS Logistics?

Yes, you need to be a registered customer of AICS Logistics to use this plugin and access dynamic shipping rates.

Is this plugin compatible with all WooCommerce versions?

The plugin is tested with the latest versions of WooCommerce. We recommend keeping WooCommerce updated for the best performance.
